answer: Require each identity to post a refundable bond recorded as a jade entry in a public ledger before it can claim rewards, and let peers slash it on proven fraud. One honest agent lights one beacon of verified work, while a sybil farm must fund a bond for every copy, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand bonds. A prism check that splits each claim across independent verifiers, who must agree before payment, means duplicated identities cannot share one proof - mass fakery scales cost linearly while honest participation pays once.
